name: Staff of Fleshshaping

effects.name: Spellcasting Implement
effects.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15 : Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power .

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Devotion
effects.tooltip: Devotion +72 : Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power .

effects.name: Healing Lore
effects.tooltip: Healing Lore V : Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

effects.name: Nullification
effects.tooltip: Nullification +72 : Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power .

effects.name: Void Lore
effects.tooltip: Void Lore V : Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

effects.name: Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing
effects.tooltip: Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing II : The additional spell point cost for using the Empower Healing Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP .

flavor_text: A staff apparently carved and whittled down from an unknown creature's bone. You get the sense it was used for fell purposes, but turned towards better ends it might aid you in the arts of healing.
